checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: 524 cycles: initial unknown holds/rotations, load priority for every enable, uniform words, both full one-hot traversals, mixed deterministic controls/data, pre-rising and post-falling holds

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; no official feedback was accessed.
Clock edge polarity is not explicit in the original; rising edge is assumed.
Original defines no initial value; DUT has no initialization or reset.
Verification is directed and deterministic, not exhaustive over every 100-bit state.
